name: Jacquet Metals SA
summary: Jacquet Metals SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the storage and distribution of special metals in Germany, France, Italy, North America, Spain, the Netherlands, rest of Europe, and internationally. It operates through JACQUET, STAPPERT, and IMS Group segments. The company distributes stainless steel and nickel alloys quarto plates for use in water, environment, energy, mechanical and forged metal construction, chemical and agri-food, gas processing and storage, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic sectors.
